recommendations.description: Defer reimbursement or UM policy changes for AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION in TX and UNATTRIBUTED / VA until UM operations, claims, and data quality validate PA-required inpatient authorization-to-claim mapping, confirm prior authorization was obtained, and review confirmed mismatches for reprocessing or denial enforcement for MEMORIAL HERMANN SOUTHWEST HOSPITAL, Kidney and Urinary Tract Infection DRGs, and Acute Myocardial Infarction with MCC.
evidence: AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION flagged auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
TX acute hospital claims center on MEMORIAL HERMANN SOUTHWEST HOSPITAL.
Kidney and Urinary Tract Infection DRGs are affected in TX.
UNATTRIBUTED / VA shows the same authorization distribution issue.
peer_benchmarking: BCBS_LA and State FFS list inpatient authorization as required.
Elevance Health (internal) lists authorization as required for applicable inpatient claims.

recommendations.description: Initiate a TX DSNP HMO ACUTE HOSPITAL prior-authorization enforcement and UM ROI/P.A.V. review focused on Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections with MCC and Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC to confirm authorization was obtained, match authorizations to actual admissions, enforce denials, review same-member repeat stays, evaluate CTI discharge-planning engagement opportunities, and confirm claims are processing to contract.
evidence: Signal is concentrated in authorization-required acute hospital claims.
TX DSNP HMO acute hospital spend rose $34.7M.
Admissions increased by 1,628 in authorization-required acute hospital claims.
Average paid per admit rose in the main TX acute signal.
Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections with MCC had higher paid per admit.
peer_benchmarking: Humana nonreimburses specified urine culture CPT codes for routine general-exam primary diagnoses.

recommendations.description: Audit TX DSNP HMO AUTH Y inpatient claims in the Not Mapped facility bucket to confirm prior authorization was obtained, match authorizations to billed actuals, verify denials were enforced, and confirm contractual reimbursement for Memorial Hermann Southwest Hospital and other acute hospital providers identified for site-of-care or contract remediation.
evidence: TX DSNP HMO claims sit in a Not Mapped facility bucket.
AUTH Y is a key driver code.
Admissions and paid per admit both increased.
Drill context identifies Memorial Hermann Southwest Hospital.
peer_benchmarking: Humana policy scope covers facility services, observation billing, medical necessity, documentation, and excluded hours.

recommendations.description: Conduct a provider-level UM and site-of-care audit at BEN TAUB HOSPITAL and PARKLAND HEALTH AND HOSPITAL SYSTEM for ER-admit acute-hospital DSNP HMO urinary infection admissions coded UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED, ACUTE CYSTITIS WITHOUT HEMATURIA, or PYONEPHROSIS to confirm prior authorization, strengthen nurse-to-MD medical-necessity referral triggers, and review inpatient site-of-care use.
evidence: UTI SITE NOT SPECIFIED added about $0.9M with MCC and $0.4M without MCC.
Those UTI signals together reflect 120 more admissions.
Top source cards name BEN TAUB HOSPITAL and PARKLAND HEALTH AND HOSPITAL SYSTEM.
Highlighted cases are ER-admit acute hospital DSNP HMO with pa_required_code Y.
Additional TX urinary diagnoses include acute cystitis without hematuria and pyonephrosis.
peer_benchmarking: Humana policy scope applies only to specified urine culture testing codes, not inpatient DRG admissions.
BCBS_TX summary shows no documented urinary admission policy scope or appeals process.

recommendations.description: Validate facility mapping for Not Mapped inpatient claims, then perform a provider-specific contract compliance and reimbursement-methodology audit for PA-required DSNP HMO and Medicare HMO admissions at ASCENSION ST VINCENT HOSPITAL in IN and UHCMC in OH, including claims reprocessing, authorization-to-claim matching, and itemized bill review of outlier stays; escalate confirmed variances to contract remediation and site-of-care action.
evidence: ASCENSION ST VINCENT HOSPITAL IN DSNP HMO Not Mapped claims rose about $0.8M.
UHCMC OH Medicare HMO Not Mapped claims rose about $0.4M.
ASCENSION ST VINCENT HOSPITAL IN Medicare HMO Not Mapped claims added about $0.2M.
All highlighted provider cards show pa_required_code Y and unmapped_or_unknown_value.
peer_benchmarking: Humana payer summary applies only to professional services, with no inpatient DRG benchmark documented.

recommendations.description: Launch a case-level reimbursement and clinical review for PA-required catastrophic inpatient admissions at ASCENSION ST VINCENT HOSPITAL and UHCMC, confirming authorization enforcement, contract-compliant adjudication, itemized bills, and contract remediation options for Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System with MCC, Tracheostomy with Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours or Principal Diagnosis Except Face, Mouth and Neck without Major O.R. Procedures, and Cardiac Valve and Other Major Cardiothoracic Procedures without Cardiac Catheterization with CC.
evidence: Variance concentrated at ASCENSION ST VINCENT HOSPITAL and UHCMC.
Driver DRGs are heart transplant, tracheostomy ventilation, and major cardiothoracic procedures.
Diagnoses include ACQUIRED HEMOPHILIA and NONRHEUMATIC MITRAL INSUFFICIENCY.
Source cards show PA required code Y on catastrophic admissions.
Flags include low volume run and repeated delta concentration.
peer_benchmarking: AmeriHealth Caritas lists no DRG-specific inpatient reimbursement relevance or documented appeals process for these cases.

recommendations.description: Launch a VA facility-level inpatient policy audit for authorization-required ACUTE HOSPITAL stays in DSNP HMO, Medicare HMO, and CSNP HMO for Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections with MCC and Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections without MCC to reconcile prior authorizations, denials, and paid claims, review UM KPIs, and validate reimbursement against contract terms.
evidence: Authorization-required acute hospital urinary infection stays drove the VA pattern.
DSNP HMO carries most of the increase across affected Medicare products.
Medicare HMO and CSNP HMO also added acute hospital admission growth.
Kidney and Urinary Tract Infections with and without MCC are key drivers.
Paid per admit increased in affected DSNP acute hospital stays.
peer_benchmarking: Humana denies routine diagnoses and requires medically necessary, non-routine primary diagnoses; Medicare LCDs may govern pathogen testing.
